payload.title: Thu 11/12: Q4 workload and the holiday calendar
payload.purpose: The season when 'I will deal with it in January' sets in. Written for a LinkedIn reader.

captions.LI:
Year-end deadlines. Holiday planning. The phrase "I'll deal with it in January" starts to feel reasonable.

If you're a working professional carrying the weight of Q4 and already postponing what matters, you're not alone. The Bariatric Counseling Center offers an Intensive Outpatient Program designed for people struggling with binge eating, chronic overeating, and weight loss, with session times that work around a full schedule.

Morning, evening, and weekend tracks. Virtual and onsite options. Behavioral therapy, dietary guidance, culinary classes, and mindful movement. One program, not four.

Covered by most health insurance plans and available across Texas. San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

Link in the first comment.

payload.alt_text: Text overlay addressing working professionals postponing health goals during Q4 workload season, promoting flexible therapy scheduling.
payload.why_now: Posted mid-November when Q4 pressure peaks and professionals begin deferring personal health decisions to the new year.
